description: A night scene at sea. A large dark lateen sail rises over a low wooden boat crowded with robed figures, several holding small lanterns, with a man in a red garment standing at the stern. A crescent moon shines through green-grey clouds above choppy dark water. On the left, a shoreline with palm trees and low flat-roofed buildings, one with a tower. A thick dark wooden picture frame surrounds the painting on all four sides, and a small white sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner. No visible text, no violence, no era-inconsistent objects.
